item.title: Programming AVR microcontrollers in Linux
item.description: A practical guide to compiling and flashing AVR microcontroller programs from Linux without relying on ATMEL Studio.

item.title: Automatize your logins with gnome-keyring (and optionally with KeePassXC)
item.description: A guide to storing passwords securely with gnome-keyring and using them from the command line, with an optional KeePassXC setup.

item.title: Better keyboard experience in Linux
item.description: Ideas and tools for making keyboard use on Linux more comfortable and productive, including keymaps, modifier keys, and useful shortcuts.

item.title: A (relatively) deep dive into (zsh) shell login process (without a display manager)
item.description: A deep dive into what happens during a zsh login without a display manager, following the relevant startup files and environment setup step by step.

item.description: A cross-platform setup for typing Unicode characters programmatically on Linux and macOS, building on keyboard remapping with KMonad.
